Vertical Insure combines technology, insurance expertise, implementation, optimization, claims, and customer support in one platform. We don’t just help you launch embedded protection, we help you make it more valuable over time.

[How it Works](https://verticalinsure.com/build-buy-or-partner/)

##### Software-first

APIs and components designed for product teams, with full control over placement, design, and experience

##### A true growth partner

We continuously optimize performance through testing and data, not just implementation

##### Vertical by design

Products tailored to your industry, your workflows, and how your customers think and purchase
